description.en: Warm off-white pages, serif headlines and a single terracotta accent for reading-first articles, portfolios and newsletters.
description.zh: 暖白纸面、衬线标题和一个陶土色强调色，适合以阅读为主的文章、作品集和通讯。

description.en: Dark graphite surfaces, a teal signal color and monospaced details for developer tools, dashboards and technical docs.
description.zh: 深石墨底色、青绿信号色和等宽细节，适合开发者工具、仪表盘和技术文档。

description.en: Bright white canvas, a violet accent, large rounded cards and friendly type for consumer apps, shops and landing pages.
description.zh: 明亮的白底、紫色强调色、大圆角卡片和亲切的字体，适合消费类应用、商店和落地页。

description.en: Cool grey neutrals, a steady blue accent, compact type and small radii for business software, reports and internal tools.
description.zh: 冷灰中性色、沉稳的蓝色强调色、紧凑字体和小圆角，适合商务软件、报告和内部工具。

description.en: Cream paper, heavy black outlines, hard offset shadows and a loud orange accent for campaigns, events and bold portfolios.
description.zh: 奶油色纸面、粗黑描边、硬投影和醒目的橙色强调色，适合活动页、宣传页和大胆的作品集。
